rendering.coordinates: Y up; original rotations; initial horizontal root and initial floor translation only; preserve root motion
rendering.scale: Common pixels/metre for all tracks in each sample
rendering.timing: Native fps; no time stretch. Preserve complete audio/motion; hold last skeleton frame or pad audio only until max duration rounded up to a frame.
rendering.reuse: Existing FP32 inference outputs; skeleton videos newly rendered.

conditioning: DualTrack examples use a reference speaker embedding.
